caption: The drawing features a solitary figure situated centrally against a plain, off-white background. The figure has short dark brown hair and is dressed in an outfit consisting of a long, ruffled, multi-layered dress colored in shades of light blue, purple, and beige, with a prominent large blue bow tied at the neck. Pale yellow and ruffled beige sleeves cover the arms, and similar ruffled material adorns the ankles. The figure's complexion is light brown, and the facial features are distinctive with large, dark eyes, a defined nose, and lips, and an expressionless look. Resting on the figure’s lap is a tan-colored object resembling a small animal, possibly a cat, curled up and sleeping, with the figure’s left hand gently resting on it. The details of the dress include visible folds and shading, and the blue ribbons extend outward from the waist, creating movement in the composition. There are no other objects or elements in the background.
title: Wax Doll
